description: This file defines a final class 'ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped' which implements a builder pattern for creating and configuring 'Policy' objects scoped to specific labels. It includes methods for setting policy attributes, managing subjects, resources, permissions, and supports method chaining.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilderLabelScoped
classes.description: A mutable builder for a Policy object scoped to a specific Label, supporting fluent API for configuration.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance scoped to a given label and delegate.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance scoped to the provided label.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with this builder.

methods.name: exitLabel
methods.description: Returns the delegate PolicyBuilder, exiting the label scope.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the policy ID, either via CharSequence or PolicyId.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the policy lifecycle.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the policy revision.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a PolicyEntry to the policy.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple PolicyEntries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry or label.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Associates subjects with a label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Associates a single subject with a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject association from a label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Associates resources with a label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Associates a resource with a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource association from a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets permissions for a resource key under a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted permissions for a resource key.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets revoked permissions for a resource key.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the configured Policy object.
